newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman shares lose steam in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: Oman shares lose steam in moderate trade.

text.p: Shares on the Oman stock exchange edged lower in the week to Wednesday in moderate trade focused on bank shares, the Muscat Securities Market said.
The stock exchange index closed lower at 305.38 points from 318.07 the previous week.
Some 73 stocks were traded in the week, of which 11 rose, 22 declined and 11 were unchanged.
National Bank of Oman ended the week lower at 7.900 rials from 8.510 rials from last week. Some 325,000 National Bank of Oman shares worth 2.56 million rials were traded.
Oman Investment and Development Co gained to 5.250 rials from 5.200 rials the previous week.
Other shares moved in a tight range.
